tldr:
For the iid population causal contrast \(\tau(P)=\mu_1(P)-\mu_0(P)\), the stipulated equal-weight A2IPW estimator has exact sequential minimax excess-variance price \(C_A=1017/16=63.5625\). The explicit original-record learner jointly estimates means and variances and attains
\(C(P)=\frac{S(P)}4\{s_0(P)\kappa_1(P)/s_1(P)^4+s_1(P)\kappa_0(P)/s_0(P)^4\}+S(P)^2\)
with a uniform summable remainder. A common-seed matrix information argument matches the worst-law coefficient over every positive predictable Borel joint policy. Moment feasibility and strict endpoint optimization force both fourth central moments to ten and unordered variances \(\{1/4,1\}\). The nonzero \(S(P)^2\) center-learning cost is certified by the common-mean information direction. The transfer proposition retains this lower coefficient for classes containing every specified interior audit neighborhood and policy subclasses, with the same fixed-estimator loss. Coverage, optional stopping, and all-estimator optimality are outside the result.
